Benny starts out with a study debt of 25,000 kroner.He begins by designing square lamps as well as the iconic BALL lamp series, initially as a wall lamp model. BALL pendant, table and standard lamps are subsequently launched.

The magnetic handles clip together securely, protecting both the blades and your fingers when stored in a drawer.
